message: You thought you could use psychology on a cat?!?! Our cats are so dumb/curious that they'll dart out the door if we're not looking, straight into a downpour, a blizzard, whatever's coming out of the sky. No matter the experience, they're (Noodles and Willie that is, two of the five--the only males, hmmm) ready to bolt the next time they get a chance. Curiosity just may kill those cats. Hope the basement gets cleaned up soon.
